THOMAS Christi Apostolus, Matth. 10.3. cum Lazaro mori exoptat, Ioan.11.16. Christum, de via quae ducat ad caelos interrogat, 14.5. incredulus primum est, 20. vers.24.25. tandem vt credat, Christi lateri manum inferre permittitur, v.27.28.(Graece Didymos. i.gemellus.)
THOV rex Emath, Dauid victori congratulatur, 2 Sam.8,v. 9.10. pacem a Dauide petit.1 Par.18.9.10.(i.errans.)

THRONVS, vide SOLIVM. Thronus Salomonis, Vide SOLOMON. Throni pro ipsis Angelis, Coloss.1.16. Throni magni visio, Apoc.20.11. Thronus gloriae, Hebraismus, pro throno glorioso & maiestatis pleno, Marth.19.28.(Thronus Dei, Ps.9.v.5.8. Dei Patris Apoc.1,4.& 3.21.& 4. v. 5.9. 10.& 5.v.1.6.7.11.13.& 6.16.& 7.v.9.10.11.15. & 8.3. & 12.5. & 14.5.& 16.17.& 19.v.4.5. Filij Dei, Messiae. THVBALCAIN filius Lamech, artis fabrilis inuentor, Gen.4.22.(i.mundana possessio.)
THVS offerendum, & quomodo, Leuit.2.v.1.2.&c. thus offertur Christo a Magis, Matth.2.11.
THVRIBVLA Core, Dathan & Abiron in monimentum sceleris eorum conseruata, Num.16.39.40. Vide 2 Paral. 26.19.
THYATIRORVM in urbe Paulus instituit Lydiam purpuriam, Actor.16.14. Thyatirensium Ecclesia, Apoc.2.18.
TIBERIAS, vrbs Galilaeae, ab Herode rege in honorem Tiberij Caesaris condita: Ioh.6.1.23.
TIBICINVM vsus in exequiis olim solennis, Matt.9.23.
TIBIIS cecinit Christus Iudaeis, Matth.11.16. Luc.7.32.
TIGRIS fluuius. Gen.14. Dan.10.4. Hiddekel vocatur.
